explication: HandyControl is a cross-framework desktop UI-control library, with WPF and Avalonia implementations and accompanying demo applications. The user-facing path is exploring a demo, selecting a control example, and seeing the control rendered; the tree supports those stages, though sampled code does not establish the navigation wiring. The graph also captures control families, window chrome, and shared interaction infrastructure. Evidence is limited to the supplied excerpts and source index; unverified demo wiring is dashed.
